issues.detail: The Greek 'οι ραβδουχοι' (the rod-bearers/messengers) is plural, but the Vietnamese 'hai người' (two people) specifies a number not present in the Greek text.

The Greek 'οι ραβδουχοι' refers to the messengers/guards who reported the news, but the Vietnamese 'hai người' (two people) makes it sound like only two individuals were being discussed or were the ones reporting.
